task_text: A guest is coming over in 15 minutes. The house should feel welcoming — somewhere comfortable to sit, and something to offer them when they arrive.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare a light snack or beverage by gathering items from the kitchen and pass them to R2.
central_instructions.R2: Arrange the living room by pushing furniture if needed to create a comfortable seating area and receive items from R1 to place on the table.
central_instructions.R3: Assist by picking up any light objects needed from the bedroom and pass them to R2 if necessary.
central_instructions.R4: Ensure the bathroom is tidy by picking up any light objects and passing them to R2 if needed.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the mug from the sink basin. (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the tomato from the counter. (r1_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [PASS] Pass the mug to R2. (r1_s3)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the mug from R1. (r2_s1)
- R1 [PASS] Pass the tomato to R2. (r1_s4)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the tomato from R1. (r2_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Arrange the mug and tomato on a tray for the guest. (r2_s3)
agent_plans.R2:
## Plan

[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Push the armchairs closer to the coffee table to create a comfortable seating area. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Adjust the sofa to ensure it faces the coffee table and armchairs for a welcoming arrangement. (r2_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive snacks or drinks from R1 to place on the coffee table. (r2_s3)
- R1 [PASS] Hand over snacks or drinks to R2. (r1_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] Place the received items on the coffee table for the guest. (r2_s4)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the small pillow from the bed. (r3_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [PASS] Pass the small pillow to R2 for arranging on the living room sofa. (r3_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the small decorative item from the dresser. (r3_s3)
- R3 [PASS] Pass the decorative item to R2 to place on the coffee table. (r3_s4)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Pick up any light objects on the counter (r4_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [PASS] Pass light objects to R2 for storage or disposal (r4_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Check the floor for any light objects and pick them up (r4_s3)
- R4 [PASS] Pass any additional light objects to R2 (r4_s4)
